tool.description: List, add, generate, or remove the bookmark/outline tree of a PDF. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. Use mode=list to inspect bookmarks, mode=apply with `bookmarks` to write an indented 'Title | page' outline (or JSON), mode=per-page to add one bookmark per page, and mode=remove to strip the outline. Writing options include replace, expanded, show_pane, zoom, and per_page_label.

bookmarks.description: Outline to write when mode=apply. Use one 'Title | page' entry per line, indent children with spaces or tabs, and optionally add attributes such as 'bold', 'italic', or '#3366cc'. A JSON array of {title,page,children} entries is also accepted.

expanded.description: When writing bookmarks, store nested sections expanded/open in supporting PDF viewers. Default true.

mode.description: Operation to perform: list existing bookmarks, apply the supplied outline, create one bookmark per page, or remove all bookmarks. Default list.

per_page_label.description: Label template for mode=per-page. Use {n} for the page number and {total} for page count, e.g. 'Sheet {n} of {total}'. Default 'Page {n}'.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

replace.description: When mode=apply, replace the existing outline if true; append after existing bookmarks if false. Default true.

show_pane.description: When writing bookmarks, request that PDF viewers open the bookmarks/outline pane. Default true.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

zoom.description: Bookmark destination zoom: fit whole page, fit-width, or keep the reader's current zoom. Default fit.
